name: main
sql: SELECT ToolName AS tool, quantile(0.5)(DurationMs) / 1000 AS p50_s, quantile(0.9)(DurationMs) / 1000 AS p90_s, sum(DurationMs) / 60000 AS total_min FROM agent_session_events WHERE EventKind = 'tool_call' AND TimeUnixMs >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND TimeUnixMs < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} GROUP BY tool ORDER BY total_min DESC LIMIT 8
